{"parse":{"title":"Bicycle factory","pageid":21,"redirects":[],"text":"
Cost $3,100, 200x rubber,
10,000x wood, 500x steel
Inputs 24x aluminum, 8x rubber
Outputs 1x bicycle
Production interval 1 minute and 30 seconds
Profit/Min $160.00
Profit/Hour $9,600.00
Aliases bicycle factory, bicyclefactory,
bike factory, bikefactory, bike fac

The bicycle factory is a facility that produces 1x bicycle every 1 minute and 30 seconds.

You need 14/3 Steel mills and 32/9 Rubber factories to produce a bike, of which have components.

To fully automate production, you need 2/3 of a Coal mine, 28/9 of a Iron mine, 14/3 Steel mills, and 32/9 Rubber factories to fully sustain 1 bicycle factory.
